about.title: About Quebal Quiros CPA
text: Our firm is focused on providing quality service and client satisfaction - we will do everything we can to meet your needs.

Dave S. Quiros is an Enrolled Agent and Certified Fraud Examiner with 13+ years of experience in taxation, accounting, and bookkeeping. He has managed daily operations related to taxation, sales tax, payroll, general accounting, cash and treasury activities, and financial for clients.

Before his career in tax and accounting, he served as a Project Director for a National Institutes of Health (NIH) funded grant at Columbia University's Mail School of Public Health, where he conducted research, assisted the Principal Investigator, and collaborated on statistical analyses and manuscript writing.
